mcqs.question:
With reference to the announcement regarding US dollar notes carrying President Donald Trump's signature, consider the following statements:

1. It will be the first time a sitting President's signature appears on US currency.
2. The $100 note will be the first denomination to carry the signature, beginning in June 2026.
3. The move marks the 250th US Independence Day on July 4, 2026; since 1861, only the Treasurer and the Treasury Secretary had signed US currency.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. The $100 note is scheduled to carry Trump's signature first in June 2026, marking the 250th US Independence Day; since 1861, only the Treasurer and Treasury Secretary had signed US currency. The options excluding statement 1 or statement 3 are therefore incorrect.

mcqs.question: Which body approved the 24-carat gold coin bearing Donald Trump's image in March 2026?
options: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency
mcqs.explanation: The Commission of Fine Arts approved the 24-carat gold coin bearing Trump's image. The World Health Organization, Pan American Health Organization and European Union Aviation Safety Agency are not the body identified with this approval.
